guide.title: Bounded explanation and repair search
guide.summary: redundant predicates, minimal distinguishing sets and least-cost feasible repairs (conjunction keep sets, BOOL-001 programs with baselines, separations and membership explanations, ATTR-001 games, row deletions under SQL aggregates) as minimum-cost subset searches, exhaustive or branch and bound with admissible bounds, in index, cost or exact Shapley / Banzhaf order: the exact minimum with every tie, or an explicitly incomplete answer with proven lower / upper bounds and the explored states when the state budget stops it; value edits and threshold changes through INV-002; algebraic, never causal.

ATTR-002.cpu: Native C (math_repair.c; the evaluators, bounds and search drivers inline in math_repair.h): immutable subset problems over at most 62 elements with an exact feasibility test per subset: hitting sets of inclusion-minimal masks (declared; the minimal difference sets of the distinct three-valued or SQL-selection patterns of two row sets of a BOOL-001 domain, or of a program's selected and other points: minimal distinguishing sets and membership explanations; the minimal failure sets of a conjunction's rejected points: keep sets whose complements are jointly redundant), a BOOL-001 program with the conditions outside S at declared baseline constants that must select exactly the same points (SQL three-valued logic, the exact count of differing points), an ATTR-001 game (v(S) or v(P - S) against an exact threshold), or deletions of declared rows under COUNT(*), COUNT, SUM or AVG targets with SQL NULL semantics (exact 128-bit sums, magnitude bounds proven at construction). Searches over positive exact rational costs scaled to integers: exhaustive in increasing (cost, mask) order, or best-first branch and bound with admissible bounds (a disjoint-mask packing for hitting sets, the exactly rounded fractional relaxation for deletions) and sound pruning only, in index, cost or exact ATTR-001 Shapley / Banzhaf order; results found (the exact minimum, every tie counted and listed up to a limit), none (proven) or incomplete when the declared state budget stops the search (proven lower and upper bounds, multiplicity bounds when the minimum is known, explored states and open nodes). Redundancy of every allowed condition with exact counts and witness rows. Continuous repairs through INV-002: value edits by its exact LP or projection, single-threshold changes by its aggregate state, the new constants computed natively.
ATTR-002.gpu: math_repair_gpu.cu: tr_mgpu_repair_eval evaluates a batch of candidate subsets, one work item per candidate writing its exact counts and value into its own slot (hitting masks, word-parallel BOOL-001 programs in three-valued logic with baselines, ATTR-001 game values, deletion aggregates); tr_mgpu_repair_scan marks the feasible candidates by atomic OR, takes the smallest feasible cost by atomic minimum and then the ties of that cost by atomic OR; tr_mgpu_repair_search runs the shared exhaustive and branch-and-bound drivers of math_repair.h with these kernels as its evaluators. Results do not depend on the order of the threads and equal the CPU bit for bit (emulated with a scrambled thread order in the tests); the output and device-byte budgets are checked on the host before launching. Continuous repairs and the ATTR-001 orders are CPU only.
budgets: Problems: variables = elements; tensor = pattern pairs (separations, explanations); support = the masks kept (declared masks: the copy before minimization); circuit = program nodes; bytes = the copies.
Evaluation: output = candidates, bytes (CUDA: every device copy and the scratch chunk).

Search: iterations = max_states (a larger space gives an incomplete result with proven bounds, never a refusal), output = max_solutions, bytes = the frontier, the batches and the sorted order; Shapley / Banzhaf orders add ATTR-001's needs. Redundancy: output = elements x (1 + witnesses). Thresholds: variables = conditions, output = changeable conditions.
limitations: Subsets are 64-bit masks: at most 62 elements; a weighted exhaustive search sorts its 2^m subsets (m <= 20).

The search is exponential in the worst case: admissible bounds exist for hitting sets and linear deletion targets only; circuits, games and != targets branch with the generic bound (the cheapest undecided element), so large ones end incomplete under a state budget, with proven bounds.
Continuous repairs (value edits, threshold changes) are CPU only, through INV-002, and change one declared threshold at a time; the CUDA path is the batched candidate evaluation and scan.
No FND-007 certificate kind is emitted for minimality: optimality is proven by the exhaustive order or by the bounds and redundancy by exact counts; every result is algebraic, never causal.
